## Insurance Data Engineer Job Market Analysis

This project involves analyzing the job market for insurance data engineers, focusing on trends, demand, and required skills. The analysis includes data collection from job postings, statistical analysis, and visualization to provide insights into the current state of the job market for professionals in this field. This project was done through a Big Data and Cloud Analytics course through Boston University, and was a group project.
